taskEnvelope.objective: Publish explicitly authorized sanitized Codex Cloud evidence copies to the existing evidence branch
acceptanceCriteria: All available original/r1/r2 execution logs inventoried with raw and public SHA256
Sensitive values removed and residual scan verified
Only new evidence subtree added; existing paths and main unchanged
Original failures and candidate-specific claims retained
constraints: No source changes, product tests, force push, install or sharing changes

allowedActions: Publish sanitized evidence copies via a nonforce evidence branch push
prohibitedActions: Modify main, candidate branch, existing evidence folders, credentials or operational state
Publish raw private archives, databases or keys
